name: Chicken Salad with Chickpeas, Cucumber, Almonds, Feta & Citrus Dressing (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 2 large and 2 mini food storage containers.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Transfer almonds to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
1 orange
½ English cucumber
1 head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.

Juice lemon and half of the orange into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, whisk to combine the dressing, then divide between the mini containers. (Reserve remaining orange for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Divide between the large containers.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the containers with the lettuce.

Cut off skin and white pith from reserved orange; slice between the membranes to release segments. Cut flesh into bite-sized pieces, then add to the containers along with chickpeas, toasted almonds, and feta.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is cool, thinly slice and add to the containers.
Cover large and mini containers, then refrigerate. When ready to eat, drizzle salad with dressing, and enjoy!
